selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Primary brand+AI story: premium broadcast-brand-aligned redesign, behavioral design, agentic engineering integrated into the build. Hits brand strategy mechanics AND AI-driven development in one artifact.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: Primary leadership story: first design hire builds the function — hiring, governance, decision rights. Maps verbatim to the JD's 'restructure teams, clarify decision rights, redesign ways of working'.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Brand mechanics with technical depth (OKLCH, k-means, accessibility math). Shows that brand strategy at this level is also an engineering decision.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Real-proof-point for 'agentic workflows' — Claude Code prototype-to-production, not a vendor pitch. Concrete artifact for the JD's most-emphasized requirement.
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Enterprise / regulated / data-dense breadth. Confidential — executive format only and behind 'Show more work' to honor that flag.

selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: HIDDEN: brand-mechanics slot already filled by bibeltv-color-api. Reachable via ?all.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: HIDDEN: second AI proof, less strategic framing than agentic-engineering.
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: HIDDEN: Ninox already represented by ninox-org-building, which is the stronger signal for this role.
